q: The company decided to ___ the project due to lack of funds.
e: abandon 放弃(计划/项目/希望)。线索: 缺资金→放弃项目。abolish 废除(法律/制度); resign 辞职。搭配: abandon the plan / abandon hope。

q: Plants ___ water through their roots.
e: absorb 吸收(水分/光线/知识)。线索: 植物通过根___水。digest 消化(食物/信息); attract 吸引。搭配: be absorbed in 专心于(高频)。

q: The witness gave an ___ account of what happened that night.
e: accurate 准确的、精确的。线索: 目击者描述必须准确。adequate 足够的; eventual 最终的。搭配: an accurate description / accurate information。

q: She ___ a good knowledge of French by living in Paris for years.
e: acquire 习得、获得(知识/技能)。线索: 住巴黎多年→习得法语。形近: require 需要; inquire 询问。搭配: acquire knowledge/skills。

q: It took him several months to ___ to the cold climate in the north.
e: adapt to 适应(新环境)。线索: 花了几个月___寒冷气候。形近: adopt 采纳/收养。搭配: adapt to the climate / adapt the novel for the screen 改编。

q: Make sure the food supply is ___ for all the guests at the party.
e: adequate 足够的、充分的。线索: 食物供给要够所有客人。elegant 优雅的; equivalent 等价的。搭配: adequate for / adequate supply。

q: We ___ that online sales will double by the end of next year.
e: anticipate 预期、预料。线索: 明年底线上销售翻倍是对未来的预期。形近: participate 参加(participate in)。搭配: anticipate that + 从句 / anticipate doing。

q: It was ___ to everyone that she was upset by the bad news.
e: apparent 明显的、显而易见的。线索: 每个人都看得出她难过。近义: obvious / evident。形近: appropriate 得体的; approximate 大约的。搭配: It is apparent that...

q: Winter is ___ and the days are getting shorter and shorter.
e: approach 临近、接近(v.)。线索: 白昼变短→冬天临近。approach 还有名词高频义: 方法(an approach to)。搭配: the approach of winter / a new approach to teaching。

q: Casual clothes are not ___ for a formal job interview.
e: appropriate 恰当的、得体的。线索: 便装对正式面试不得体。搭配: appropriate for/to the occasion。名词 appropriation 挪用(超纲)。

q: Tickets for the concert are ___ at the box office or online.
e: available 可获得的、有空的。线索: 门票在售票处或网上可获得。搭配: available for / available to sb(高频)。available 人作主语=有空: Are you available tomorrow?

q: Language differences are often a ___ to effective communication.
e: barrier 障碍、屏障。线索: 语言差异阻碍交流。搭配: a barrier to sth(固定搭配, to 是介词后接名词)。近义: obstacle。

q: Regular exercise ___ your health in many ways.
e: benefit 有益于(v.)。线索: 经常锻炼对健康___。搭配: benefit from 从...中获益(高频); for the benefit of 为了...的利益。

q: The government launched a ___ to encourage people to save energy.
e: campaign (社会)运动、活动。线索: 政府发起节能___。搭配: launch a campaign 发起运动; a campaign against smoking。

q: She is fully ___ of solving the problem on her own.
e: capable of doing sth 有能力做某事。陷阱: able 后面只能接 to do(able to solve), 不能接 of! 这就是搭配考点。competent/qualified 后也接 to do 或 for。

q: Under no ___ should you share your password with others.
e: under no circumstances 决不、无论如何不(固定短语)。考点: 否定短语放句首时句子要部分倒装(Under no circumstances should you...)。

q: Dozens of companies are ___ for the same government contract.
e: compete for 为争夺...而竞争。线索: 几十家公司争夺同一份合同。搭配: compete with/against sb for sth。名词: competition / competitor。

q: I cannot ___ on my study with all this noise going on outside.
e: concentrate on 集中注意力于。线索: 噪音让我无法___学习。近义: focus on。名词 concentration。

q: I am ___ that our team will win the championship this year.
e: confident (that) 确信的、有信心的。搭配: be confident of sth / be confident that + 从句。名词 confidence 自信; 形近 confidential 机密的。

q: He lost his job as a ___ of the serious mistake he made.
e: as a consequence of 由于...的结果(高频短语)。线索: 犯大错→丢工作的结果。形近: sequence 顺序; 近义: result / outcome。形容词: consequent(超纲)。

q: The research project requires a ___ amount of time and money.
e: considerable 相当大的、可观的。线索: 项目需要相当多的时间金钱。经典形近陷阱: considerate 体贴的。搭配: a considerable number/amount of。

q: Many volunteers ___ their spare time to the community center.
e: contribute...to 把...贡献给。三胞胎辨析: contribute 贡献 / distribute 分发 / attribute 把...归因于(attribute A to B)。名词 contribution。

q: Is this Saturday ___ for you to come over and discuss the plan?
e: convenient for sb 对某人方便。陷阱: 中文说 你方便吗, 英语不说 Are you convenient, 要说 Is it convenient for you / Is Saturday convenient for you?

q: Sleep plays a ___ role in memory and learning.
e: crucial 至关重要的。线索: 睡眠对记忆和学习的作用至关重要。搭配: play a crucial role in(写作高频句型)。近义: vital / essential。形近: cruel 残忍的。

q: Sales of the product began to ___ after the holiday season ended.
e: decline 下降、衰退; 还有高频义: 婉拒(decline an invitation)。线索: 节后销售___。形近: declare 宣布; decorate 装饰。

q: The store ___ groceries to your door free of charge.
e: deliver 递送(包裹/货物)。熟词僻义: deliver a speech 发表演讲(高频)。名词 delivery 快递。

q: It is hard to ___ the twin sisters from each other.
e: distinguish A from B / distinguish between A and B 区分、辨别。线索: 双胞胎难以___。形近: disturb 打扰。形容词: distinctive 有特色的 / distinct 清晰的、不同的。

q: The new machine is far more ___ than the old one, saving both time and energy.
e: efficient 高效的(强调过程效率高, 省时省力)。经典辨析: effective 有效的(强调结果达到目的)。线索: saving both time and energy 指向效率。搭配: an efficient worker / energy-efficient。

q: Clean water is ___ for the survival of all living things.
e: essential 必不可少的。线索: 干净的水对生存___。搭配: be essential to/for sth(高频)。近义: vital / necessary。

q: There has been a ___ improvement in his English since he started practicing daily.
e: gradual 逐渐的、循序渐进的。线索: 每天练习→英语逐步提高。搭配: a gradual change/increase/improvement。副词 gradually。形近: graceful 优雅的 / grateful 感激的。

q: In the meeting, the manager will ___ the safety concerns raised by the workers.
e: 熟词僻义: address 处理、解决(问题)= deal with。你熟悉的是地址, 四级考动词! 搭配: address the issue/problem/question。

q: This color really ___ you — you should buy the dress.
e: 三胞胎: fit 指大小尺寸合身; suit 指颜色款式适合、衬托人; match 指两物之间相配(The shoes match the dress)。线索: 颜色适合你→suits。

q: The lecture ___ for three hours, and nobody left early.
e: 熟词僻义: last 作动词=持续(The rain lasted two days)。你熟悉的是最后的(形容词)。maintain 维持/保养; lengthen 加长(及物)。

q: Can you ___ the difference between the original painting and the copy?
e: 熟词僻义: tell 分辨、区分= distinguish。搭配: tell A from B / tell the difference。say/speak/talk 都没有分辨义。

q: The school has ___ a new teaching method to improve class efficiency.
e: 铁三角: adopt 采纳/收养 / adapt 适应/改编 / adept 形容词 熟练的。线索: 学校___新教学方法→采纳 adopt。

q: The new policy will ___ thousands of workers in this industry.
e: affect 是动词 影响; effect 是名词 影响(have an effect on)。本题缺动词→affect。effort 努力(n.); offer 提供。考点: 词性辨析。

q: The ___ reason for the delay was the bad weather, not the traffic.
e: principal 主要的( adj.)/校长(n.); principle 原则、原理(n.)。记法: principal 里有个 pal 伙伴→校长是你的主要伙伴; principle 以 -le 结尾像 rule 规则→原则。

q: The sun ___ in the east and sets in the west.
e: rise 不及物 升起(sun/moon/price rise); raise 及物 举起/抚养(raise your hand/raise children); arise 不及物 产生(问题出现 problems arise); arouse 及物 唤醒/激发(arouse interest)。

q: Please ___ the book on the desk before you leave the room.
e: lay 及物 放置(过去式 laid); lie 不及物 躺(躺: lie-lay-lain)/说谎(lie-lied-lied)。本题宾语 the book→需要及物动词 lay。四级最爱考的三态变化。

q: I was delighted to ___ their invitation to the graduation ceremony.
e: receive 收到(客观收到, 不一定接受); accept 接受(主观愿意)。我可以 receive 一份邀请却 choose not to accept it。线索: 欣然地→主观接受。
